context: The agent must add entries-for to bank_ledger/core.clj, deduplicating by :id because of a stated upstream webhook-redelivery quirk. Key discriminator: an agent without the idiom either omits the why entirely (dedup logic with no explanation), or over-explains with a multi-line comment block restating what the code does step by step instead of the one load-bearing reason it exists.

checklist.name: Correct functional behavior
checklist.description: entries-for filters ledger entries by tx-type and removes duplicates by :id

checklist.name: Captures the load-bearing why
checklist.description: A docstring or comment explains the redelivery/dedup reason (why the dedup exists), not just that it happens

checklist.name: Comment is concise, not a block
checklist.description: The why explanation is a docstring or at most 1-2 short comment lines, not a run of 5+ consecutive ;-comment lines

checklist.name: No redundant what-comments
checklist.description: No comment is added that merely restates what the code already says (e.g. '; filter entries', '; dedup by id')

checklist.name: record-entry left unchanged
checklist.description: record-entry is unmodified other than the new function being added
